USAGE:
    bbt pr [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information
                                         
COMMANDS:
    list            List pull requests (default: --state OPEN)                  
    view            View pull request details (id inferred from current branch  
                    if omitted)                                                 
    summary         Show normalized pull request summary metrics (id inferred   
                    from current branch if omitted)                             
    diff            Show pull request diff (raw in human mode, structured in    
                    --json; id inferred from current branch if omitted)         
    comments        List pull request comments (default: newest-first, one page 
                    unless --paginate/--limit requires more; id inferred from   
                    current branch if omitted)                                  
    threads         List pull request comment threads (root + replies; ordered  
                    by discovery sort (default: -created_on); id inferred from  
                    current branch if omitted)                                  
    comment <ID>    Post a pull request comment (global/inline/reply; inline    
                    default: --side to)                                         
    review <ID>     Set pull request review status (approve/request changes;    
                    --body posts global comment first)

        --contains <TEXT>          Filter comments containing text              
                                   (server-side). Equivalent to

    -q, --query <EXPR>             Bitbucket q expression (server-side          
                                   filtering)
